name: vehicle_exhaust_emissions
title: Vehicle exhaust emissions from fuel flow and gas fractions (MCI TP7 exercise 1)
summary: Teaching exercise: CO, NO2 and HC emissions of a vehicle in g/kg fuel, g/km and g/kWh of brake work, from the fuel mass flow, the excess-air factor and the wet-gas mole fractions, converted to mass fractions with the molar masses and the exhaust-gas molar mass.

origin.course: ULiège MCI, TP séance 7, exercise 1 (vehicle exhaust emissions).

verification.summary: The runnable variant was compared with the stored solution of EX_1_PNG_2019.EES (compare_solution.py): 30 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001), largest relative difference 3.13e-05 on MM_HC (CoolProp C3H8 vs EES molar mass). The 9 emission-index records dropped by the extractor (CS-BUG-EXTRACT-FMT-BYTE) were recovered by hand. Native file fails on molarmass(NO2).
verification.reference: EES stored solution of EX_1_PNG_2019.EES (54 records; 45 decoded by ees_extract.py, 9 recovered by hand decoding)
verification.notes: Comparison concerns the variant (the native file is blocked by CS-GAP-FLUIDS-NASA-SPECIES, molarmass(NO2)). The 24 EES-only variables belong to the commented-out CO2 combustion block of the source and carry default guesses, except f_st (0.06702) and AFR_st_bis (14.92), consistent with the diesel formula C12H26 assumed there. Variant MM_NO2 = molarmass(N)+2*molarmass(O) = 46.0055 vs stored 46.006 kg/kmol (1.1e-05). Max rel. diff 3.13e-05 on MM_HC.
